# model-provider/catalog/baseline

The `ModelCatalogSource` provider (`model-provider/catalog`'s host service) of a host without the computer — the browser composition. There is no Claude CLI to discover a menu from, so the catalog is the code baseline, `BASELINE_MODELS` (the catalog of a machine that never probed its CLI), and it never changes. The desktop never boots it (`base-exclusions`, `plugin-meta/composition`); `catalog#machine` provides the desktop's discovered `catalog.json`.
